mapper.insert: insert into _main_slide(ms_name, ms_tText, ms_bText1, ms_sText, ms_bText2, ms_btnText, ms_btnUrl, ms_src, ms_startdate, ms_enddate) values(#{ms_name}, #{ms_tText}, #{ms_bText1}, #{ms_sText}, #{ms_bText2}, #{ms_btnText}, #{ms_btnUrl}, #{ms_src}, #{ms_startdate}, #{ms_enddate})
mapper.select: select * from _main_slide order by ms_enddate desc
select * from _main_slide where ms_startdate < now() and ms_enddate > now()
